parameters.label: Genome protein sequence files

parameters.desc: Index of genome to be used as reference (1-based)
parameters.label: Index of genome to be used as reference
Minimum coverage of query and subject

source.content:
{
    "id":"GenomeComparison",
    "script":"App-GenomeComparison",
    "label":"Blast-based genome proteome comparison",
    "description":"Compare the proteome sets from multiple genomes using Blast",
  "default_memory": "100G",
    "parameters":[
        {
            "id": "genome_ids",
            "allow_multiple": true,
            "required": 0,
            "default": null,
            "label": "Genome IDs",
            "desc": "Genome IDs",
            "type": "string"
        },
        {
            "id": "user_genomes",
            "allow_multiple": true,
	    "required": 0,
	    "default": null,
	    "label": "Genome protein sequence files",
	    "desc": "Genome protein sequence files in FASTA",
	    "wstype": "feature_protein_fasta",
	    "type":"wstype"
        },
         {
            "id": "user_feature_groups",
            "allow_multiple": true,
            "required": 0,
            "default": null,
            "label": "User feature groups",
            "desc": "User feature groups",
            "wstype": "feature_group",
            "type":"wstype"
        },
        {
            "id": "reference_genome_index",
	    "required": 0,
	    "default": 1,
	    "label": "Index of genome to be used as reference",
	    "desc": "Index of genome to be used as reference (1-based)",
	    "type": "int"
        },
	{
	    "id": "min_seq_cov",
	    "label": "Minimum coverage of query and subject",
	    "required": 0,
	    "default": 0.30,
	    "type": "float"
	},
	{
	    "id": "max_e_val",
	    "label": "Maximum E-value",
	    "required": 0,
	    "default": 1e-5,
	    "type": "float"
	},
	{
	    "id": "min_ident",
	    "label": "Minimum fraction identity",
	    "required": 0,
	    "default": 0.1,
	    "type": "float"
	},
	{
	    "id": "min_positives",
	    "label": "Minimum fraction positive-scoring positions",
	    "required": 0,
	    "default": 0.2,
	    "type": "float"
	},
        {
            "id":"output_path",
            "label":"Output Folder",
            "required": 1,
            "default":null,
            "desc":"Path to which the output will be written. Defaults to the directory containing the input data. ",
            "type":"folder"
        },
        {
            "id":"output_file",
            "label":"File Basename",
            "required": 1,
            "default":null,
            "desc":"Basename for the generated output files. Defaults to the basename of the input data.",
            "type":"wsid"
        }
    ]
}
